get.summary: Gets rates associated with a quote, per plan.
get.description:
An age rate is a plan specific premium for an enrolled member based on their age. The rate will apply to all enrolled members who are the given age at the effective date of the plan. For this response, the tier will represent the age the premium is associated with. Anything 14 and under is considered the same rate and anything 65 and above is considered the same rate.
            A composite rate is a plan rate for a specific family tier. The rate will apply to all employees that fall into the specific family tier based on the family members that enroll in the plan. For this response, the tier will represent the coverage tier the premium is associated with.  Values for the supported four coverage tier rate structure include; Employee, Employee + Spouse, Employee + Child, and Family.
            A level funded rate will return tiers similar to a composite rate, but may also include a breakdown of the different components that make up the rate.

parameters.name: quoteId
parameters.description: The unique Zywave identifier for a quote.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: The filter used to find the desired quoted plans

parameters.name: $orderBy
parameters.description: The properties used to order the search results

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: The number of records in the result set to skip

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: The maximum number of records after the first skip records to take from the remaining result set

200.description: A paged collection of rates, per plan, for a specified quote.

For more information on how to work with the Search endpoints within the Zywave API check out OData Search within the Zywave API documentation.
 
 The following properties can be used when filtering and ordering the response:
 
| Search parameter | Use case | 
| ------- | -------- |
| accountId   | Retrieve quotes related to an account in Zywave.    | 
| effectiveDate | Retrieve quotes based on the effective data of the plans within the quote. | 
| updateDateTime   | Retrieve all quotes based on when the quote was last updated.    | 
| status   | Retrieve all quotes with a specific quote status. This field can be used to only return quotes that have been marked sold/final.   | 
| isArchived  | Filter the quotes returned based on whether the quote is archived.   | 
| state   | Retrieve all quotes for a specific state.      |
